kill_switch.pass_condition: No request is emitted after the kill state becomes active; evidence is retained.
kill_switch.test: Arm before a bounded acquisition step and prove that the next network request count remains unchanged.

rollback.pass_condition: State digest equals the pre-campaign checkpoint and no public authority is expanded.
rollback.test: Restore the pre-campaign CANDIDATE, zero-claim, zero-notification state from the retained checkpoint.

measurement_window.rationale: Last complete calendar month before campaign execution.

permitted_delta.from: buyer-country IN ({country}) AND publication-date >= 20260701 AND publication-date <= 20260731 SORT BY publication-number ASC
permitted_delta.reason: TED expert-query grammar accepts SORT BY publication-number and rejects the SQL-style ASC token.
permitted_delta.to: buyer-country IN ({country}) AND publication-date >= 20260701 AND publication-date <= 20260731 SORT BY publication-number

exclusion_rules: exclude records outside the frozen publication window
exclude missing or malformed publication numbers from the measured sample
exclude duplicate publication numbers after preserving duplicate-rate evidence
exclude natural-person buyer records from retained normalized data when detectable
exclude all contact endpoints and contact-person values from persisted records
exclude attachments, full XML, full HTML, source-native full text and third-party works
exclude any response obtained after authority expiry or authority mismatch
sampling.pagination_rules: Fetch exactly pages 1 and 2, at most 100 notices per page; never iterate beyond the frozen page budget.
sampling.query_contract: buyer-country IN ({country}) AND publication-date >= 20260701 AND publication-date <= 20260731 SORT BY publication-number
sampling.replacement_rules: If a stratum has fewer than 15 parseable unique notices, retain all available notices and do not replace from another country.

stop_conditions: authority envelope missing, invalid or expired
target head, target tree, manifest reference or authority artifact mismatch
official terms baseline missing, expired or changed
DNS resolves to any non-global address
redirect or host leaves the exact HTTPS allowlist
contact value written to disk, logs or retained artifacts
attachment, full notice XML, full notice HTML or source-native full text retrieved
query or pagination differs from the frozen contract
candidate source contributes to public claims
fabricated or synthetic evidence enters campaign reports
kill switch cannot stop acquisition before another network request
rollback cannot restore the pre-campaign CANDIDATE and no-claim state
